over_annotation_rule: Only tag non-speech events when they are clearly audible and meaningful. Don't label every tiny breath or background noise.

numbers.rule: If speaker said Arabic number → Arabic word. If French → French word. If unclear → flag for review. NEVER convert between languages.
numbers.note: Digits must be written out in the language the speaker used.

dardja_spelling.rule: Use canonical spelling for common words only. Preserve regional/pronunciation variants. Never change meaning or pronunciation.
dardja_spelling.apply_when: word matches a canonical entry exactly (no fuzzy)

french_spelling.rule: Use correct French spelling. Preserve code-switching. Never translate French to Arabic or vice versa.

non_speech_tags.rule: Insert only when clearly audible AND meaningful. Never infer from words alone. [ضجيج] only for significant noise, not ambient.

punctuation.rule: Collapse ... → ., ؟؟؟ → ؟, !!! → !. Preserve meaningful pauses and questions.

mixed_script_tokens.rule: Split accidentally joined Arabic+Latin when intended words are clear. Example: رانيgoing → راني going.

number_word_spacing.rule: 3commandes → 3 commandes. Always space between number and word.

values.verified: Reviewer listened carefully and confirmed transcript
values.accepted_quick: Accepted without careful listening — requires verification before training
